description: In frame 0, Baxter's left gripper descends on the far left of the table near a white-and-red box and a yellow fiducial-tagged object; across frames 1-3, the left arm retracts upward out of the left side of the frame while the black-masked participant stands facing the table with a white tablet on the right.

Baxter's left gripper holds a white pouch/object with a fiducial marker horizontally above a white-and-red box and a purple fiducial-tagged carton on the left side of the table (frames 0-2), then lifts the held white object higher in frame 3 while the black-masked participant stands upright in front of the green screen.

In frame 0, Baxter's left gripper holds a blue-and-white object at the lower left edge of the table next to a white-and-red box and a yellow fiducial-tagged object; in frames 1-3, the left arm has retracted out of view, leaving the white-and-red box, gray rectangular box, and yellow fiducial object on the table while the black-masked participant watches.

Across all 4 frames, Baxter's left arm is positioned vertically on the left side of the workspace holding a blue block above a white-and-red box and a yellow fiducial-tagged object on the dark tabletop, while the black-masked participant stands turned slightly toward the robot's right arm.

Baxter's left gripper holds a dark rectangular box on a blue tray horizontally above the left edge of the table (frames 0-2) and raises it upward in frame 3; meanwhile, the black-masked participant tilts their head (frames 0-1), turns to the left (frame 2), and raises their right hand to the top of their head (frame 3).

Across all 4 frames, Baxter's left arm remains extended vertically downward on the left side of the table with its red two-finger gripper poised directly over a vertical blue block resting on a white base plate beside a yellow fiducial-tagged object, failing to lift the blue block while the black-masked participant leans forward watching.

Both of Baxter's arms are retracted out of the central workspace across all 4 frames, leaving the dark tabletop empty except for white tape markers on the lower left while the black-masked participant stands upright in front of the green screen.

Across all 4 frames, a dark box with a white fiducial marker rests at the far lower-left corner of the table on the tape markers while Baxter's left arm is out of view and the black-masked participant stands facing the left side of the workspace.

Across all 4 frames, Baxter's left arm stays stationary on the left with its red gripper positioned above a blue vertical block on a white base plate next to a yellow fiducial-tagged object; the black-masked participant stands with their left hand on their hip (frames 0-1), then lowers and extends their left arm toward the right side of the table (frames 2-3).

Across all 4 frames, Baxter's left arm is out of view and the tabletop shows only white tape markers on the left and a white tablet on the right, while the black-masked participant stands with hands near their waist facing the workspace.
